title: SchemaWeaver: Accelerating On-Device Mobile Agentic AI via Schema-Guided Parallel LLM Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2610.17436v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) on mobile devices can act as agents that call external software tools to complete complex tasks, but the major challenge of supporting on-device mobile agentic AI with LLMs is the long latency of LLM tool calling on mobile devices. In particular, the decode phase is the main contributor of such long latency, but is hard to speed up on mobile processors as it is bound by memory bandwidth rather than compute power. To address this limitation, in this paper we present SchemaWeaver, a new on-device mobile agentic AI technique that enforces schema-guided parallel decoding in the decode phase of LLM tool calling, to reduce its latency by producing multiple tokens in each decode pass. translated_title: SchemaWeaver：通过模式引导的并行LLM解码加速端侧移动智能体AI
translated_abstract: 部署在移动设备上的大语言模型（LLM）可以作为智能体调用外部软件工具来完成复杂任务，但利用LLM支持端侧移动智能体AI的主要挑战在于移动设备上LLM工具调用的长延迟。其中，解码阶段是造成长延迟的主要因素，但该阶段在移动处理器上难以加速，因为它受限于内存带宽而非计算能力。为解决这一局限，本文提出了SchemaWeaver，一种新的端侧移动智能体AI技术，它在LLM工具调用的解码阶段强制执行模式引导的并行解码，通过在每次解码过程中生成多个token来降低延迟。SchemaWeaver可以通用地应用于移动设备上的LLM推理引擎，无需任何训练工作或对LLM本身进行修改，我们在主流移动SoC和多个LLM系列上的实验结果表明，SchemaWeaver能够（原文此处截断）显著降低延迟。
tldr: 提出SchemaWeaver技术，在移动端LLM工具调用的解码阶段引入模式引导的并行解码，使每次解码生成多个token，无需训练或修改模型即可有效降低端侧智能体AI的推理延迟。
en_tdlr: SchemaWeaver accelerates on-device mobile agentic AI by enforcing schema-guided parallel decoding in the LLM tool-calling decode phase, producing multiple tokens per decode pass to reduce latency without any training or model changes.
